[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":106,"var":"data/size","code":"uint8_t *copy = malloc(size); memcpy(copy, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a heap buffer so the fuzzer can present them as an in-memory file."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":111,"var":"copy","code":"memfile = hopen(\"mem:\", \"rb:\", copy, size);","note":"The raw input becomes the backing storage for an hFILE memory stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":116,"var":"ht_file","code":"htsFile *ht_file = hts_hopen(memfile, \"data\", \"rb\");","note":"hts_hopen parses the memory stream and classifies the input as SAM/VCF/other based on its contents."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":118,"var":"ht_file->format.category","code":"switch (ht_file->format.category) { case sequence_data: view_sam(ht_file); case variant_data: view_vcf(ht_file); }","note":"If the parser recognizes sequence or variant data, the fuzzer immediately drives the corresponding reader over the attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":129,"var":"fn","code":"memcpy(fn, data, size); memcpy(fn + size, \"##idx##X\", 8); htsFile *idx = hts_open(fn, \"r\");","note":"A second attacker-controlled filename is synthesized to force the ##idx## path in hts_open and exercise filename splitting logic."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/htslib/hts.c","function":"hts_open_format","line":619,"var":"fnidx/rmme","code":"char *rmme = NULL, *fnidx = strstr(fn, HTS_IDX_DELIM); if (fnidx) { rmme = strdup(fn); rmme[fnidx-fn] = 0; fn = rmme; }","note":"When the crafted filename contains ##idx##, hts_open duplicates it and truncates at the delimiter before opening the data file."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/htslib/hts.c","function":"hts_open_format","line":626,"var":"hfile","code":"hfile = hopen(fn, smode);","note":"The truncated filename is opened, and any malformed prefix or delimiter placement propagates into the low-level stream layer."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/htslib/hts.c","function":"hts_open_format","line":629,"var":"fp","code":"fp = hts_hopen(hfile, fn, smode);","note":"The opened stream is wrapped into an htsFile, where format detection and later parsing can reach the memory-safety sink."}
]
